import json
def increment(path):
    try:
        with open(path,encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            data = json.load(handle)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return None
    data["count"] += 1
    with open(path,"w",encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(data,handle,indent=2)
    return data["count"]
